description: This file contains the ADOdb Date Library, providing extended date functions such as adodb_date, adodb_mktime, adodb_getdate, and related utilities to handle dates beyond PHP's native 32-bit timestamp range. It includes deprecated notices, conversion functions, leap year checks, and gregorian corrections, and is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer for PHP.

methods.name: adodb_time
methods.description: Returns the current Unix timestamp, using PHP's DateTime class.

methods.name: adodb_getdate
methods.description: Returns an array with detailed date and time information for a given timestamp, supporting dates outside PHP's native range.

methods.name: adodb_date
methods.description: Formats a timestamp into a date string according to a specified format, supporting dates outside the native range and handling GMT conversions.

methods.name: adodb_mktime
methods.description: Creates a Unix timestamp from given date/time components, supporting dates outside PHP's native range.

methods.name: adodb_gmdate
methods.description: Formats a date/time in GMT/UTC timezone.

methods.name: adodb_gmmktime
methods.description: Creates a GMT/UTC Unix timestamp from given components, supporting dates outside the native range.

methods.name: adodb_strftime
methods.description: Formats a date/time according to locale-specific formats, supporting extended date range.

methods.name: adodb_gmstrftime
methods.description: Formats a GMT/UTC date/time per locale-specific formats.

methods.name: adodb_date2
methods.description: Formats a date given in ISO string format or timestamp into a specified format, considering GMT if specified.

methods.name: adodb_last_date_status
methods.description: Returns boolean indicating if the last date calculation failed or exceeded cutoff.

methods.name: adodb_dow
methods.description: Computes the day of the week for a given date, with special handling for Gregorian calendar corrections.

methods.name: adodb_get_gmt_diff
methods.description: Calculates the timezone offset from GMT for a given date, supporting historical timezone differences when available.

methods.name: adodb_get_gmt_diff_ts
methods.description: Returns the GMT offset for a timestamp, considering historical timezones if possible.

methods.name: adodb_validdate
methods.description: Checks if a given date is valid according to calendar rules and range constraints.

methods.name: adodb_is_leap_year
methods.description: Determines whether a given year is a leap year, supporting Gregorian and Julian calendars.

methods.name: adodb_year_digit_check
methods.description: Converts 2-digit years to 4-digit years, assuming specific century logic.
